what: A synthwave groovebox: Juno pads, supersaw leads, pulsing basses and 80s drum machines. Pick a mood and one chord progression drives every track; WRITE drafts a part for each sound and VARY turns a bar into a 4-bar phrase. About 220 presets sorted by role.
author: Neon Summers
sounds: CC0: Hügelton Sample Pack (assets/samples-cc0, from Felucca)
